Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:

  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB confirms Morgan Swanson (E037) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training; basic training means max is read. Requested write to Payroll exceeds the max (read), so recommend read.
